_doc: The AI opponent (src/ai/bot.gd): an economy, a build order, attack waves and counter-picks. Times in seconds; army sizes in population (large units count 2).

economy._doc: max_workers: per age, the most workers it trains. age_workers: with this many it stops training workers and saves for age 2; age3_workers: with this many in age 2 (and a guard) its soldiers and research leave the age-3 cost alone. rebalance_every: seconds between moving one gatherer to the resource most short of its share (shares: the mix, less a resource piled up or saved for what it's saving for, the next age or a blocked build step).

_doc_mix: economy.mix: per age, the share of workers on each resource (the bot sends idle and new workers to whatever is furthest below its share, and moves one gatherer at a time over to it)
_doc_build_order: each step: a building, from `age`, once it has `workers`; `near` lays it by the nearest patch of that resource (`away`: at least that many tiles from the Town Center); `builders`: workers sent (2 by default); `count`: how many of that building the step wants in all (default: one more than the steps before it). Steps go in order; a later age's step doesn't hold up this age's. A step it can't afford yet is what it saves for (economy shares).

military._doc_healers: healers (Town Center, from age 2): one per per_army soldiers, up to max per age; kept `behind` tiles back from the army's middle (towards home); idle ones further than `follow` tiles from that spot are sent there every `every` seconds

towers._doc: after a raid on its buildings or workers within `within` tiles of its Town Center (not at the Town Center itself, which shoots), once quiet, it raises a Watchtower by the spot (up to the level's `towers`, one at a time)

shelter._doc: a raid within `tiles` of the Town Center by at least the level's `shelter_pop` of enemy population, more than its soldiers at home can answer: call to arms (workers into the Town Center and towers); once quiet, back to work

research._doc: Besides line upgrades (and gathering, for building-up levels): the economy research it buys (economy, then buildings: the University's, Bastion once it has a tower), and the soldiers' research it buys once that research reaches at least army_min of its soldiers (the armoury track for what it fields). Both keep back what it's saving for (the next age, a blocked build step) once it has the workers to age up.
research._doc_wait_for: wait_for: research it leaves until it has that building (the Bastion's stone waits for the Castle's)

wonder._doc: a Wonder (bot.gd _wonder): from `age`, with none of its own standing or going up, once its stock of every resource is at least spare_pct percent of the Wonder's cost, it lays one by its Town Center and sends `builders` workers. Every bot also attacks a Wonder it knows of (seen, or finished: everyone hears of that) before anything else, and a finished one at once

levels._doc: difficulty, as in the genre: easier bots build up more and fight less, but grow all game (no caps, up to the population limit). delay: seconds added to every wave's time; army_pct: the share of each wave's minimum army; army_ratio: soldiers kept (population) as a percent of its workers per age (50: half its workers in age 1, as many in age 2, one and a half in age 3; absent: no limit); wave_pct: the share of its army each wave sends (the rest defend); build_up: research gathering and line upgrades before soldiers; age3_workers: workers before it saves for age 3 (economy.age3_workers otherwise); towers: Watchtowers it raises where it was raided; shelter_pop: the raid (enemy population) that makes it call its workers to arms (absent: never). (Dominic: not caps; less focus on fighting, more building up.)
